changes: Defer request-limited listings without recording failures or incrementing attempts; retain the existing default 100-call page cap.
Encode Unicode URLs for HTTP transport while preserving original URLs in exports.
Separate recoverable warnings from fatal errors; authentication, unexpected code errors and a complete capture outage still fail.
Checkpoint and publish at cooperative processing budgets: 1200 seconds for listings and 2700 seconds for photos.
Avoid redundant full OCR during removal-mask selection; retain full property-sample OCR and post-edit residual checks.
Allow one bounded retry for transient image-browser connection failures.

unicode_url_live_check.method: Direct requests from the local environment with encoded transport URLs; no paid proxy calls.

github_regression.purpose: Exercise request-cap deferral and checkpoint/publication with a deliberately small run, not a full daily batch.

limitations: The full daily production batch was not rerun after the fix; the scheduled workflow will use the new defaults.
Processing deadlines are cooperative and allow in-flight requests, image processing and final checkpoint/publication to finish.
